_readme.units: Distances in meters, angles in degrees.
_readme.world_frame: Right-handed, x = east, y = north, z = up (ENU). Origin is on the ground under the start gate.
_readme.rpy_deg: Orientation as [roll, pitch, yaw] in degrees, applied in the order yaw (about z), then pitch (about y), then roll (about x). Yaw 0 faces +x (east), yaw 90 faces +y (north). Positive pitch tips the nose down.
_readme.ids: Integer ids, unique within each list (quads, gates, trees).
_readme.quads: Starting pose of each quad. position is the quad's center.
_readme.gates: position is the center of the gate opening. Fly through each gate in the direction it faces (its +x axis). Gates are raced in the order listed; the first gate is the start/finish line.
_readme.gate_size: Shared by all gates. inner_width/inner_height are the size of the opening; frame_width is the thickness of the frame bars around it.
_readme.trees: position is the base of the trunk, on the ground. The trunk is a cylinder of trunk_radius and trunk_height; the canopy is a sphere of canopy_radius sitting on top of the trunk.
_readme.comments: Any key starting with '_' is a comment and is ignored by the loader.
